checks.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) >= 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS failed, COUNT(*) AS observed FROM "oncology_labs"."lab_results" WHERE COALESCE(_fivetran_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE

checks.description: One row per subject, visit and test across all deliveries
checks.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS failed, COUNT(*) AS observed FROM (SELECT "subject_key", "visit", "test_code" FROM "oncology_labs"."lab_results" WHERE COALESCE(_fivetran_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE GROUP BY "subject_key", "visit", "test_code" HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) d

SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(_fivetran_synced) >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '30' HOUR THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS failed, COUNT(*) AS observed FROM "oncology_labs"."lab_results" WHERE COALESCE(_fivetran_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE

checks.description: Every lake row comes from a loaded delivery
checks.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "oncology_labs"."lab_results" x WHERE COALESCE(x._fivetran_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "oncology_labs"."pf_entity_audit" a WHERE a.package_sha256 = x.pf_package_sha256 AND a.entity = 'lab_results' AND a.status = 'loaded')) AS failed, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "oncology_labs"."lab_results" WHERE COALESCE(_fivetran_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE) AS observed
